resources.string: To reopen settings, tap all four corners of the image viewer frame, in any order, within five seconds.\n\nUse HTTPS: HTTP sends credentials unencrypted. Redirects to a different origin are blocked. Settings are encrypted on this device. Disabling Remember clears the saved view.
The username cannot contain a colon or line breaks.
